subgoals.goal_text: Battle wild Pokemon in Viridian Forest or Route 2 to raise the party's level, as the current level 6 Charmander is too weak for the route.
Travel north from Viridian City to Route 2
Enter the Viridian Forest south gate building
Pass through the gate into the Viridian Forest
Navigate through the Viridian Forest and exit through the north gate
Travel north from Route 2 to enter Pewter City
